 ORDER

This Miscellaneous Appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 has been filed being aggrieved by the award passed by the 2nd Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Itarsi in MACC No. 34/2021 dated 28-06- 2023 by which the Insurance Company has been directed to pay the compensation to the LRs of deceased Rupendra Yadav.

entities.text: 2nd Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Itarsi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
2. Learned counsel for the appellant/Insurance Company has submitted that the claim petition was filed against the owner/driver/Insurance Company of the motor-cycle bearing registration No.
MP-04-MV-1079 wherein the documents of criminal case were filed in support of the claim petition,
criminal case the motor-cycle No. MP-05-MW-4563 was involved and the charge-sheet has been filed against the owner/driver/Insurance Company of MP-04-MV- 1079. Though, the driver/owner/Insurance Company are the same and as per Ex.P/7 also, the offending vehicle as mentioned is MP-05-MV-1079 and the same vehicle was recovered from the possession of Ajay Meena- respondent No. 5 but,the claim petition has been filed against the owner/driver/Insurance Company of motor-cycle No. MP-04-MV-1079 and the Tribunal has framed issues against that vehicle and also awarded claim.
Thus, the Claims Tribunal have without going through the vehicle no. had wrongly awarded the compensation.
3. Learned counsel appearing for the claimants has submitted that this is error has occurred in the impugned award.

4. Looking to the factual aspect as stated above, award passed by the claims tribunal is quashed and the case is remanded to Claims Tribunal with a direction that after giving opportunity to the claimants to amend the claim petition and shall amend the issues and after recording evidence of parties shall decide the claim petition afresh.
5. With the above direction, the appeal is allowed and disposed of.
